answer: Require every new agent to stake a deposit tied to a single hardware-backed vertex in a trust graph, where reputation is earned only through verifiable work witnessed by established peers. A newcomer starts on a narrow ledge: limited permissions, no voting weight, and its stake slashed if it misbehaves. Only after a history of consistent, useful attestations does it cross the canyon to full participation. Forging thousands of identities would then mean funding thousands of deposits plus years of honest work, which costs far more than a sybil attack can ever gain.
